verdict.rationale: Warp documents typing '#' on the command line and describing the command in natural language, with Warp generating the matching command in real time in place, including inside interactive CLI tools. A daily user independently praises the 'AI generated commands at your fingertips.' missing for 10: the feature is now labeled 'Generate (Legacy)', which raises a deprecation/longevity concern, and there is no hands-on evidence about how accurate the generated commands are (the 'right' command).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can type natural language and get the right shell command generated in place

citations.quote: Generate (Legacy) turns natural language queries into precise terminal commands or contextual suggestions inside interactive CLI tools. Type `#` in the command line to describe what you want, and Warp generates the matching command in real time.
Type '#' on your command line and start describing the command you want to run using natural language. Warp will load AI Command Suggestions as you type.
contextual suggestions inside interactive commands and programs, whether you're using psql, gdb, git, mysql, or any other CLI tool.
The best features are being able to edit commands, chunking the output into blocks and AI generated commands at your fingertips.
